newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Afghan ex-government forces take airfield.
newsitem.headline: Afghan ex-government forces take airfield.

text.p: Ousted government forces backed by artillery commanded by Uzbek General Abdul Rashid Dostum captured Bagram airbase, Bagram Junction and the town of Qarabagh north of Kabul overnight, witnesses said.

Reporters who travelled to the areas about 60 km (40 miles) north of the capital found that Taleban forces had vacated all three places and that troops and tanks commanded by former military chief Ahmad Shah Masood were in firm control.
Sources from the ousted government had announced that the airbase was captured after a fierce artillery barrage by Masood and Dostum forces at about 8 p.m. local time on Friday.
Soldiers at the junction said it fell a short-time later and that Qarabagh had been taken early on Saturday.
